title: Black Friday Weekend Live: The Biggest Weekend For Whatnot Sellers
summary: This year, Whatnot is bringing the excitement back to Black Friday, with four days of non-stop giveaways and live entertainment from some of the biggest names on the internet. And we’re backing it all with more ways for sellers to make the most of the moment,, plus with lower commission for sellers,
body_markdown:
This year, Whatnot is turning up the excitement on Black Friday weekend, where the best deals are free and happening live. Join us from November 27-30 for non-stop giveaways, deals on your favorite products and live entertainment from some of the biggest names on the internet.


Over these four days, MrBeast, Shay Mitchell, Kai Cenat, Claudia Oshry, Ben Soffer, David Dobrik and more are going live with exclusive giveaway shows. This packed lineup is designed to put more shoppers in front of Whatnot sellers than ever before.


And we’re backing it all with more ways for sellers to make the most of the moment, with lower commission, up to $1 million in Whatnot gift card giveaways, and a day to highlight thousands of Whatnot’s small sellers.


Here's a look at just a few of the weekend’s headliners, plus what's in it for sellers and shoppers alike.


### **The lineup, day by day**


-


**Friday, November 27:** Catch Kai Cenat giving away 100 PlayStation 5s and 100 copies of Grand Theft Auto VI, live on Black Friday, to kick off the weekend.


-


**Saturday, November 28:** Whatnot’s first ‘Small Seller Saturday’ for Black Friday. This is where shoppers will discover their next favorite seller with up to $1M in Whatnot gift card giveaways.


-


**Sunday, November 29:** MrBeast is going live with 100 surprises for a record-breaking Whatnot event.


-


**Monday, November 30:** For the grand finale, Shay Mitchell and FashioNica go live with BÉIS luggage, luxury bags and dream destination experiences, and Claudia Oshry and Ben Soffer of Girl With No Job give away their holiday wish lists.


### **Our Lowest Fees On The Biggest Shopping Weekend Of The Year**


For our sellers, we're lowering our commission to its lowest level of the year, so they keep more of what they sell.


-


**Black Friday, Friday, November 27:** 0% commission for all Whatnot sellers


-


**Small Seller Saturday, November 28:** 0% commission for eligible small sellers*


-


**Sunday and Monday, November 29 and 30:** 50% off commission for all Whatnot sellers


*Each offer runs from 12:00am to 11:59pm in your local time. Standard payment processing fees still apply.*


### **Why Black Friday Is Better On Whatnot For Shoppers**


No lines, no endless scrolling through product listings, no generic discounts. This Black Friday weekend the best deals you can find are free: four days of non-stop live shows, incredible small businesses, surprise drops and giveaways you can win just by tuning in.


-


Giveaway shows every day from November 27 to 30.


-


Deals dropping with flash and fire sales throughout the weekend.


-


$1M worth of Whatnot gift cards as giveaways in seller shows


-


$10 off your next $30 purchase, with coupons dropping all weekend long.


*The rules for each giveaway are listed in the show.*


### **Small Seller Saturday**


Saturday, November 28 is Small Seller Saturday. We're putting up to $1M in Whatnot gift cards in the hands of nearly 10,000 small sellers in the US and Canada to give away to their communities in their shows, so shoppers can discover new favorite sellers, and even our smallest businesses can grow their audience. Eligible small sellers* also pay 0% commission that day.


Want in?[Schedule your show now.](http://whatnot.onelink.me/56MH/bfwl) Full details are in the[Help Center](https://help.whatnot.com/hc/articles/50085926560141) .


### **See You Starting November 27**


Open the Whatnot app on November 27 to see who's live. And check out our[main event](https://www.whatnot.com/tag/black_friday_weekend_live) page for more details. Sellers, get your show on the schedule now so shoppers can find you.


* *Small Seller Saturday eligibility is determined as of 12:00AM on November 24, 2026, in your local timezone. You qualify if, at the cutoff, you are on the “Base” commission tier (you can check your rate card in Seller Hub) and are not on a custom rate card. Seller must be in good standing. Terms apply.*


*Daily promos are automatically applied to eligible sellers and run from 12:00AM to 11:59PM in your local time. Standard payment processing fees still apply.*[Learn more .](https://help.whatnot.com/hc/articles/50085926560141)
